notes.title: April Overhaul - Patch Notes 27/04/2021
notes.content:
Following the Poor performance of the last update, we have now reworked a lot of the code to create a far more stable experience. Following testing we believe we have removed the majority of errors that led to game breaking crashes. As a result of these changes, we do recommend a clean installation.

Please be aware that the game is still in early access and we do not expect to have solved every issue. We ask that you continue to make us aware of any bugs or crashes you encounter. 

Please accept our apologies for the delays in fixes and we hope that you continue to enjoy Mediterranean Assault: 1943.

[b]Rebuilt squad control system [/b]
[list]
[*] The squad control system has been completely rebuilt as this was identified as one of the main reasons for crashes that we found in testing.

[*] The Player will now start with two squads under their control, upon their death or the death of the player, squads and individual soldiers will respawn at the players main objective.

[*] The Player will now start with two squads under their control, upon their death or the death of the player, squads and individual soldiers will respawn at the players main objective.

[*] The user interface and controls for squad command will remain the same.
[/list]

[b]Balanced Battles[/b]
[list]
[*] Battles now have slightly less soldiers at anyone point with AI commanders attempting to spread their teams for a better chance of success.

[*]  The number of allied teams spawned to help the player has been reduced to provide more of a challenge and a more stable performance.
[/list]

[b]Improved Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons will be more responsive during recoil, this is correcting an issue where the aiming cursor would misrepresent where the weapon was aiming during recoil.

[*] Aiming down the sight now provides a more focused view of the enemy.

[*] Weapon stats have been balanced.
[/list]

[b]Game Options[/b]
[list]
[*] Game Options have been re-added.

[*] This will allow players to adjust their turning and aiming speeds, view controls and remove markers and Icons they do not want.
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Update: Gameplay Balance
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/u]

Balanced suppression – made changes to the suppression system to help make it balanced and effective against the AI.

Balanced Levels - we have made several major changes to the skirmish levels. this will allow for more balanced gameplay between each side. We have also made level changes to prepare for the coming Vehicles update.

AI Spawning changes – made changes to the timings and location of AI spawns, this should again help the balance and flow of gameplay. In addition this has also corrected a bug spawning AI on the ground or clipping through terrain.

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

- Fixed an issue whereby the player could not capture objectives.
- Fixed an Issue stopping the player from reloading.

notes.title: Gameplay Updated: Suppression
notes.content:
Fix and Flank your enemies with the suppression system. Supressed enemies and allies will struggle to effectively return fire or move freely. Gain superiority and overwhelm your opponents.

Features include:
- New Markers for enemies and allies displaying the team and level of suppression.
- Once suppressed the player or AI will be unable to move freely or aim while firing.

Other Fixes
- Improved AI navigation over obstacles.

notes.title: Patch Notes 20/02/2021
notes.content:
- Resolving an error causing the game to crash when attempting to enter cover.
- Resolved an issue where the first aid kits would not heal the player.
- Altered Character collision to ensure that both the player and NPCs cannot access areas of the maps they are not supposed to. This was also causing an error where the player could not capture objectives.

We have also made changes to the level streaming code which should benefit performance.
